title: Intro: the stand-in airport
caption: Caption 'Find Your Way Inside: stand-in airport' top centre; Demo controls low-left; the mode panel is about to appear.

title: Choose Walk
caption: Caption 'Choose Walk, once for the whole trip'; the 'How are you getting there?' panel with Walk and Step-Free (wheelchair).

title: Scan the sign
caption: Caption 'Scan the you are here sign'; the scan sign stands about 2.5 m ahead with its Scan sign button.

title: The blue line appears
caption: Caption 'Follow the blue line through the hall'; the 'offline map' badge; the blue floor line runs straight ahead into the check-in hall, escalator on the right.

title: Walking the hall
caption: Midway to the escalator: the line still leads ahead; the escalator steps are on the right.

title: Ride the escalator
caption: Caption 'Ride the escalator up' at the escalator foot; the gold Ride escalator up button is the next action.

title: On the concourse
caption: After the ride: card 'Escalator up to Departures' (the ride card names the level once); caption 'On to the departures concourse'.

title: Gate change coming
caption: Caption 'Gate change B12 → C3' before the Demo controls button is pressed.

title: Gate change card
caption: Notice card 'Gate change B12 → C3' top-right (with chime); the line swings round toward the C pier.

title: Line swings to the C pier
caption: Caption 'The line swings round to the C pier'; the new route concourse > C pier top > C3.

title: Stairs down
caption: Caption 'Stairs down to the C pier' at the top of the stairs (Walk takes the stairs).

title: Walking to C3
caption: Card 'Stairs down to C pier' after the ride; caption 'Within 3 m of Gate C3: arrived'.

title: Arrived at C3
caption: Arrival card 'Gate C3. Boarding in 6 min.' (the demo moves straight on, so the next caption 'Restart: now in a wheelchair' is already showing).

title: Restart
caption: Caption 'Restart: now in a wheelchair'; Restart trip pressed, the mode panel is back.

title: Choose Step-Free
caption: Caption 'Choose Step-Free, seated height'; the mode panel before Step-Free (wheelchair) is pressed.

title: Same sign, Step-Free
caption: Caption 'Same sign, same gate B12'; scanning again at seated height.

title: Line to Lift 1
caption: Caption 'The line goes round the corner to Lift 1'; no escalator or stairs in the Step-Free route.

title: At Lift 1
caption: Caption 'Lift 1 is out: pinch the red sign' at the Lift 1 door; the red out-of-service sign hangs at about 1.2 m.

title: Lift 1 out of service
caption: Card 'Lift 1 out of service. Re-routing.' (the route used Lift 1); caption 'Re-routed to Lift 2'; the turn arrow points back through the hall.

title: Heading to Lift 2
caption: Caption 'Re-routed to Lift 2'; walking (wheeling) back through the hall toward Lift 2.

title: Ride Lift 2
caption: Caption 'Ride Lift 2 up to Departures' inside Lift 2; the floor button is next to the traveller.

title: Lift ridden
caption: Card 'Lift up to Departures' after the ride; caption 'Step-free all the way to Gate B12'.

title: Arrived at B12
caption: Arrival card 'Gate B12. Boarding in 6 min.' at the end of the step-free route (next caption 'Same Lens, another map: a campus' already showing).

title: Campus map
caption: Caption 'Same Lens, another map: a campus'; Map: Campus on Demo controls; the mode panel.

title: Campus, Step-Free
caption: Caption 'Step-Free to Lecture Hall 1'; the main gate sign before scanning; outdoor quad ahead.

title: Science lift
caption: Caption 'Science lift out: re-routed' at the Science building door; the red sign by the Science lift.

title: Science lift out of service
caption: Card 'Science lift out of service. Re-routing.'; caption 'Up the ramp instead'; the turn arrow points to the ramp.

title: To the ramp
caption: Caption 'Up the ramp instead'; the line leads to the ramp foot.

title: Ramp ridden
caption: Card 'Ramp up to First floor' after the ride; caption 'Arrived at Lecture Hall 1'.

title: Arrived at Lecture Hall 1
caption: Arrival card 'Lecture Hall 1. Lecture starts in 10 min.'.

title: End
caption: Caption 'That's the demo. Find Your Way Inside.'; all 24 beats reached, three arrival cards shown.

title: DC1 Scan → line
caption: After scanning the sign (Walk): the blue line starts at the sign and runs into the hall; badge 'offline map'. The green 'RUNS: …' text is LEAF's own overlay.

title: DC2 At the escalator foot
caption: Rendered from the traveller's pose at the escalator foot: the escalator and its gold ride button; the line goes up the escalator.

title: DC2 Turn arrow
caption: At the escalator top facing back (south): the next turn is behind, so the blue turn arrow shows at the lower edge of view, pointing the way.

title: DC3 Lift 1 closed
caption: Seated Step-Free after pinching Lift 1's red sign: card 'Lift 1 out of service. Re-routing.' and the line re-routed toward Lift 2.

title: DC3 Lift 2 ridden
caption: From the pose at the top of Lift 2: card 'Lift up to Departures'; the route continues to B12.

title: DC3b Seated rider
caption: Seated traveller 0.5 m from Lift 2 (feet 0.45 m below the floor) rode the lift: card 'Lift up to Departures'.

title: DC4 Gate change (Walk)
caption: From the escalator top: card 'Gate change B12 → C3'; the line swings toward the C pier stairs.

title: DC4 Gate change (Step-Free)
caption: Step-Free after the gate change: card 'Gate change B12 → C3'; the route uses Lift 2 and the ramp, no stairs.

title: DC5 Arrival at C3
caption: 2.9 m from Gate C3: the line has stopped and the arrival card 'Gate C3. Boarding in 6 min.' is shown (the frame is rendered from the start view, so the gate itself is far off-screen).

title: E2 Broken download
caption: A broken downloaded map: card 'Map couldn't load', badge 'offline map', and the built-in map still routes (line visible).

title: E3 No step-free route
caption: Both lifts out: card 'No step-free route. Ask staff at the assistance point.'.

title: E3 At the assistance point
caption: From the traveller's pose 1 m from the assistance point: arrival card 'Assistance point'. At this distance the card is very large and fills the top of the view (see report).

title: E3b Ask staff right at scan
caption: The downloaded map already has both lifts closed: the ask-staff card shows straight after the Step-Free scan.

title: E4 Already there
caption: Destination = the start sign: arrival card right away, no line.

title: E5 Unknown sign
caption: Card 'This sign isn't in the map'; nothing drawn.

title: Map: Airport after scan
caption: Airport, Walk, after scanning: line into the check-in hall; Demo controls show 'Gate change B12 → C3' and 'Map: Airport'.

title: Map: Hospital after scan
caption: Hospital wing, Walk, after scanning: line through the lobby toward the stairs; Demo controls show 'Room change Ward 4 → X-ray'.

title: Map: Campus after scan
caption: Campus, Walk, after scanning: outdoor path to the quad and the two buildings; Demo controls show 'Room change Lecture Hall 1 → Lab 2'.

title: Map: Preview room after scan
caption: Preview room, Walk, after scanning: no stand-in building; 'Window' and 'Door' signs at the sides; Demo controls show 'Change to the door'. The floor line is not visible in this frame (see report).

title: Restart: before
caption: Mid-trip after closing Lift 1 and the gate change: line drawn, card showing.

title: Restart: after
caption: After Restart trip: mode panel back, no line, no cards, no badge.

title: Gate change before the scan
caption: Gate change pressed before scanning: card 'Gate change B12 → C3' while the scan sign is still up.

title: …and it sticks after the scan
caption: After scanning (a downloaded map replaced the built-in one): the route goes to C3, not B12.

title: Closing an unused lift
caption: Step-Free route via Lift 1; pinching Lift 2's red sign shows 'Lift 2 out of service' (no 'Re-routing') and the line is unchanged.
